test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If 25 workers can build a wall in 10 days, how many days will it take for 20 workers to build a similar wall?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of workers (initial) = 25

Number of days (initial) = 10

Number of workers (new) = 20

**Formula Used:**

Work done is constant, so:

Workers₁ × Days₁ = Workers₂ × Days₂

**Calculation:**

25 × 10 = 20 × Days₂

⇒ Days₂ = (25 × 10) / 20

⇒ Days₂ = 250 / 20

⇒ Days₂ = 25/2

**It will take 20 workers 25/2 days to build a similar wall.**
